1041.description: A plate-loaded press from a lying position, working the chest with a guided path.
instructions: Lie back on the machine bench and grip the handles at chest level.
Plant your feet and keep your shoulders pulled back.
Press the handles up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep your back on the pad throughout.

1105.description: From a plank with feet in straps, you twist the hips side to side. It trains the obliques.
instructions: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps.
Keep your arms straight.
Rotate your hips to one side.
Return to centre.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your shoulders steady.

1169.description: A seated butterfly-style stretch for the inner thighs.
instructions: Sit tall on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together.
Hold your feet or ankles and let your knees fall out.
Keep your back straight and chest lifted.
Lean forward slightly from the hips until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and breathe slowly.

1233.description: Hammer curls on an incline bench, one arm at a time. The stretched position makes the biceps and brachialis work hard.
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench holding dumbbells with palms facing in.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Curl one dumbbell up without twisting your wrist.
Lower it slowly and repeat with the other arm.
Keep your upper arms still.

1297.description: Press your palms or arms together in front of your chest and hold the squeeze. A simple way to feel and train the chest with no equipment.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, parallel to the ground, with your palms facing each other.
Squeeze your chest muscles together as hard as you can, while keeping your arms straight.
Hold this position for a few seconds, focusing on contracting your chest muscles.
Release the squeeze and relax your chest muscles.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双臂伸直在身前，与地面平行，手掌相对。
尽可能用力挤压胸部肌肉，同时保持手臂伸直。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，专注于收缩胸部肌肉。
释放挤压并放松胸部肌肉。
重复所需的重复次数。

1361.description: A bent over row on a smith machine with an underhand grip. It works the upper back, lats and biceps along a guided path.
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the bar at hip height.
Stand facing the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar towards your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机设置为与臀部高度相同的杠铃。
面向杠铃站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
反手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
将杠铃拉向下胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1425.description: A one-leg press on a sled machine set at a 45 degree angle. It trains the glutes, quads and hamstrings one side at a time.
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the footplate.
Place one foot on the footplate and extend your leg, pushing the sled away from you.
Slowly bend your knee and lower the sled back to the starting position.
Repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将雪橇机调整至 45 度角。
坐在雪橇机上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚放在踏板上。
将一只脚放在踏板上并伸展腿，将雪橇推离您。
慢慢弯曲膝盖，将雪橇放回起始位置。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。

1489.description: A squat where your knees travel far forward as you lean back. It isolates the quads with only your body weight.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold onto a stable object for balance if needed.
Slowly lower your body by bending your knees and leaning back, keeping your torso upright.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as far as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
如果需要，请抓住一个稳定的物体以保持平衡。
弯曲膝盖并向后倾斜，慢慢降低身体，保持躯干直立。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行或尽可能舒适地下降。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1553.description: A side lunge combined with a biceps curl. It works the legs and arms together and also loosens the inner thighs.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward.
Take a big step to the side and sit back into that hip, keeping the other leg straight.
Curl both dumbbells up as you lower into the lunge.
Push off your bent leg to return to the middle while lowering the weights.
Alternate sides or finish all reps on one side before switching.

1617.description: A one-arm press on a decline bench with a neutral grip. It targets the triceps and the lower chest.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with a dumbbell in one hand, resting on your chest.
Extend your arm straight up, keeping your elbow slightly bent.
Lower the dumbbell down towards your shoulder, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Press the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 躺在下斜长凳上，一只手握住哑铃，放在胸前。
将手臂伸直向上，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
将哑铃向肩膀方向降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
将哑铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1681.description: Seated on a stability ball, you curl two dumbbells with palms facing each other. It hits the biceps and brachialis while the ball asks your core to stay steady.
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Plant your feet wide for balance and keep your elbows by your sides.
Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders without turning your wrists.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to full arm extension.
Keep your chest tall and avoid swinging your torso.

1745.description: A seated overhead stretch for the back of the upper arm, done on a stability ball. Helps loosen tight triceps and shoulders.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and extend your arm straight up above your head.
Bend your elbow and lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your upper arm close to your ear.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then return to the starting position.
Repeat with the other arm.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至头顶上方。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃放在脑后，保持上臂靠近耳朵。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后回到起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述步骤。

1809.description: Sitting with your soles together and reaching forward stretches your back and inner thighs. A gentle hip and back opener.
instructions: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling out.
Hold your feet and fold forward from your hips, keeping your spine long.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1873.description: Plate-loaded leg extension that isolates the front of the thighs.
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and your shins behind the roller.
Hold the handles.
Extend your knees until your legs are straight.
Squeeze your quads at the top.
Lower slowly under control.

1937.description: Pulling a bent knee toward your chest to stretch the buttock muscles.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs out in front.
Bend one knee, hold it with both hands and gently pull it toward your chest.
Keep your back tall and avoid rounding it as you pull.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2193.description: A relaxed walking-style pedal motion on a recumbent bike that builds leg endurance with the back well supported.
instructions: Sit on the recumbent bike and adjust the seat so your knees stay slightly bent at full extension.
Place your feet on the pedals and hold the handles.
Pedal at an easy, walking-like pace.
Keep your back against the backrest and breathe steadily.
Continue for 15-30 minutes.
Cool down by slowing the pedalling gradually.

2321.description: A standing biceps curl with the palms turning to face forward as you lift. Works the biceps and brachialis.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward.
While holding your upper arms stationary, curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Slowly begin to bring the dumbbells back to the starting position as your breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干。
保持肘部靠近躯干，并旋转手掌，直到手掌朝前。
保持上臂不动，弯曲哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气时慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复建议的重复次数。

2705.description: A lying dumbbell forearm pronation on the floor. Works the forearm muscles.
instructions: Lie flat on the floor with your face down and your arms extended straight out in front of you, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Rotate your palms so they are facing down towards the floor.
Keeping your arms straight, lift the dumbbells off the floor by contracting your forearms.
Continue lifting until your forearms are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在地板上，脸朝下，双臂伸直在身前，每只手各握一个哑铃。
旋转手掌，使其朝下朝向地板。
保持手臂伸直，收缩前臂将哑铃提离地板。
继续举起，直到前臂完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
保持一会儿，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2769.description: Moving the leg back behind the body, which works the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Swing the other leg straight back, keeping your knee mostly straight.
Squeeze the glute at the top, avoiding any arching of your lower back.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2897.description: A high plank holding the opposite arm and leg in the air, which tests balance and core strength.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg at the same time.
Hold them in line with your body for a moment.
Lower them back to the floor with control.
Switch to the other arm and leg and repeat.

2961.description: A plank sequence combining a push-up and a row. It trains the chest, back and core in one flowing move.
instructions: Start in a plank with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet wide.
Do a push-up, keeping your body straight.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it and row the other side.
Repeat the sequence with control.

3153.description: A burpee that finishes with a side kick. It's a tough full-body conditioning move.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Drop your hands to the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Do a push-up, then jump your feet back in.
Stand up and kick one leg out to the side.
Land and go straight into the next rep.
Alternate kicking sides.

3217.description: A modified hindu push-up that flows from a pike through a low dive to a lifted chest. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps while opening up the spine.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet hip-width apart.
Lower your body towards the ground, bending your elbows and keeping your core engaged.
As you lower your body, shift your weight back and lift your hips up towards the ceiling, creating an inverted V shape with your body.
Continue to lower your body until your chest is just above the ground, then reverse the movement, pushing your hips back down and extending your arms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
将身体向地面降低，弯曲肘部并保持核心参与。
当你降低身体时，将你的重心向后转移，并将臀部向上抬向天花板，与你的身体形成一个倒V形。
继续降低身体，直到胸部刚好高于地面，然后反向运动，将臀部向下推，并伸展手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3281.description: A full-depth back squat on the smith machine, where the fixed bar path gives extra stability. It trains the glutes, quads and thighs.
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at shoulder height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Step under the bar and position it across your upper back, resting on your traps.
Grip the bar with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and take a step back, maintaining a stable stance.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, initiate the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as your flexibility allows.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then drive through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将杠铃置于肩高的史密斯机上。
站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
走到杠铃下方，将其放在上背部上方，放在斜方肌上。
双手握住杠铃，距离略大于肩宽。
松开杠铃并后退一步，保持稳定的姿势。
保持胸部挺直，核心参与，通过将臀部向后推并弯曲膝盖来开始深蹲。
降低你的身体，直到你的大腿与地面平行，或者在你的灵活性允许的范围内尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后用脚后跟恢复到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3345.description: A wrist curl using a hand grip spring, strengthening your forearms and grip.
instructions: Sit with a forearm resting on your thigh or a bench, palm up.
Hold the hand spring in that hand.
Squeeze the handles together by curling your wrist and fingers.
Hold briefly at full squeeze.
Release slowly, finish your reps, then switch hands.

3409.description: Swim-style arm swings that loosen the shoulders and chest as a warm-up.
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing both arms forward and up in big arcs.
Swing them back down past your hips behind you.
Keep the movement loose and rhythmic.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

3473.description: A standing stretch for the outer hip that also challenges balance.
instructions: Stand tall near a support.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Sit back slightly.
Feel the stretch in your outer hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

3537.description: An inverted row with an underhand grip and elevated feet. It emphasises the lats and biceps.
instructions: Set a bar across two stable chairs and a third chair at your feet.
Lie under the bar and grip it underhand.
Place your heels on the third chair.
Pull your chest to the bar with elbows close.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your body straight.

3665.description: A plank where you shift from your hands to your forearms and back, one arm at a time. It trains the abs and shoulders.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Engage your core and squeeze your glutes to maintain a stable position.
Lower your body down onto your forearms, one arm at a time, maintaining a straight line from head to toe.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time, keeping your core and glutes engaged.
To return to the starting position, push through your forearms and lift your body back up into a high plank position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体从头到脚成一条直线。
启动你的核心并挤压你的臀肌以保持稳定的位置。
将身体放低到前臂上，一次一只手臂，从头到脚保持一条直线。
保持这个姿势所需的时间，保持核心肌群和臀肌的参与。
要返回到起始位置，请推动前臂并将身体抬回到高位平板支撑位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3729.description: A barbell press with your upper back on a stability ball, which adds a core and balance challenge.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your upper back rests on it.
Keep your hips up and take the barbell above your chest.
Lower the bar to your chest.
Press it back up to full extension.
Keep your core tight and feet planted.

3793.description: An explosive split jump with a one-arm band row. It builds power in your legs and trains your back.
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Start in a split stance with a slight bend in both knees.
Jump up and switch legs in mid-air.
Land softly in the opposite split stance and row the handle to your ribs.
Alternate legs, and switch rowing arm for the next set.

3857.description: A squat against band tension that builds the quads and glutes while the band pulls you forward, so your core has to work too.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and hold the handles at your chest, facing away from the anchor.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and brace your core.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your heels to stand up.
Repeat for the desired reps.

3921.description: A kneeling landmine press with the hands squeezed together, working the chest and core.
instructions: Kneel facing the landmine and hold the bar end close to your chest with both hands pressed together.
Brace your core.
Press the bar forward and up.
Squeeze your hands together as you press.
Lower it slowly.
Keep your torso upright.

3985.description: A push up where your hands shift one at a time to walk in and out. It adds shoulder stability to the chest drill.
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push up.
Step one hand wider, then the other.
Do another push up.
Step your hands back in.

4049.description: Hanging inverted, you move your shoulder blades to lift the body slightly. It builds the traps and scapular control.
instructions: Set up under a bar or rings and hang with straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your shoulder blades down and back to rise a little.
Hold briefly, then lower to a full hang.
Repeat for controlled reps.

4113.description: A hip hinge using a landmine barbell, training hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Stand holding the end of the bar close to your thighs.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower the bar along your legs with a flat back.
Feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

4177.description: A hang from a bar where you pull your shoulder blades down and up. It strengthens the upper back and improves shoulder control.
instructions: Hang from a pull up bar with straight arms.
Relax your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pull your shoulder blades down, lifting your body slightly.
Pause briefly.
Relax back to the hang.
Keep your elbows straight.

4241.description: Quick side-to-side steps against band tension. It trains lateral leg power, agility and glute strength.
instructions: Anchor a band at hip height or place it around your waist with a partner or post.
Get into a slight squat with your chest up.
Shuffle sideways several steps against the tension.
Keep your feet from crossing.
Shuffle back the other way under control.
Stay low throughout.

4369.description: A light, no-equipment biceps curl using self-resistance, useful for warming up.
instructions: Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Make fists and curl your hands to your shoulders.
Tense your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your elbows pinned.

4497.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the inner forearm near the elbow (pronator). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your inner forearm near the elbow (pronator) on a table with your palm facing up.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4561.description: A squat with the heels raised on a small platform, shifting more work to the quads and allowing a deeper knee bend.
instructions: Place your heels on a small plate or wedge, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Bend your knees and sink down with your chest tall.
Let your knees travel forward over your toes.
Drive back up through your whole foot.
Keep your core tight throughout.

4625.description: A compound core move that links a sit-up, a Russian twist and an overhead press with a dumbbell.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding dumbbells at your shoulders.
Sit up and rotate your torso to one side.
Rotate back to center and press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and roll back down.
Alternate sides each rep.

4689.description: A split squat with band resistance, building the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
instructions: Stand in a split stance with the band under your front foot and handles at your shoulders.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to rise.
Complete your reps and switch legs.

4753.description: A side lunge paired with an overhead press. It trains the legs and shoulders together.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your shoulders.
Step out wide to one side and sit your hips back into a side lunge.
Keep the other leg straight and your chest up.
Push back to the middle and press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower to your shoulders and lunge to the other side.

4817.description: A hip hinge with a kettlebell held at the chest. It strengthens the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to stand tall again.

4881.description: A glute bridge where you press the knees apart at the top. It fires up the outer hips and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips into a bridge.
Keeping the hips high, open both knees out to the sides.
Bring the knees back together without dropping the hips.
Lower slowly to the floor and repeat.
Keep your ribs down so your lower back does not arch.

4945.description: A standing chest stretch with the hands clasped behind your back. It opens the front of the chest.
instructions: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms.
Lift your chest and gently raise your hands.
Feel the stretch across the chest and shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

5009.description: Standing calf raise from a raised platform for a full range of motion. It builds the calves.
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step and your heels hanging off.
Hold something for balance.
Rise high onto your toes.
Pause and squeeze your calves.
Lower your heels below the step slowly.

5073.description: Squat with a wide stance and a kettlebell hanging between your legs. It works the glutes, inner thighs and quads.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of you.
Keep your chest tall and back flat.
Sit down between your legs until your thighs are about parallel.
Push your knees out over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.

5201.description: A dumbbell curl in which the weights are held and curled up in front of the shoulders. It trains the biceps.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your upper arms close to your body and your elbows tucked in.
Slowly curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders, keeping your wrists straight.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
保持上臂靠近身体，肘部内收。
慢慢地将哑铃向上弯向肩膀，保持手腕伸直。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

5265.description: A twisting bicycle crunch with the torso leaning back at 45 degrees. It strongly targets the abs and obliques.
instructions: Sit and lean back to about 45 degrees with your feet raised.
Place your hands behind your head.
Bring one knee in as you twist the opposite elbow toward it.
Alternate sides in a pedalling motion.
Keep your chest lifted and your core tight.

5393.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the outer thigh. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under the outer thigh.
Place the roller under the outer thigh and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll from the hip down to above the knee.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5649.description: Rocking on your back in a hollow body position to challenge your core.
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your arms and legs into a hollow position.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Rock back and forth like a boat.
Keep your body rigid.
Continue for reps or time.

5905.description: From hands and knees, you extend one leg back and curl the knee toward your nose. Works the abs and mobilizes the spine.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a neutral spine.
Extend one leg behind you and look slightly forward.
Round your back and draw the knee toward your nose.
Extend again and repeat for 6-8 reps.
Switch legs.

5969.description: A fast foot drill over a pattern of dots that builds foot speed, ankle stability and coordination.
instructions: Mark five dots on the floor like the five on a die.
Stand on the balls of your feet next to the pattern.
Hop quickly from dot to dot in your chosen order.
Keep your hops small and your knees soft.
Work for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

6033.description: A seated or lying tuck that draws knees and chest together to train the abs.
instructions: Sit on the floor and lean back slightly.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your knees to your chest as you bring your torso forward.
Extend again under control.
Keep your core braced.

6097.description: A dynamic combo of a backward leg kick with an overhead arm press. It works the shoulders and glutes together and raises your heart rate.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands at shoulder height.
Press both hands straight overhead as you kick one leg back.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Bring the hands and foot back to the start.
Switch legs and repeat at a lively pace.
Keep your core tight throughout.

6161.description: A leg curl lying on your front while holding a dumbbell between your feet. It targets the hamstrings.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench.
Grip a dumbbell between your feet.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze the hamstrings at the top.
Lower with control.
Keep your hips on the bench.

6545.description: A wall-supported handstand held in place, building shoulder strength, balance and body control.
instructions: Place your hands on the floor a short distance from a wall.
Kick up carefully until your heels rest on the wall.
Push the floor away and keep your arms straight.
Tighten your core and glutes.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then come down with control.

6737.description: A side plank with a band around the legs while raising the top leg. It works the outer hip and the side of the trunk.
instructions: Put a band around your thighs or ankles and get into a side plank on your forearm.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Raise the top leg up against the band.
Pause briefly.
Lower the leg with control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

6801.description: A seated overhead press combined with in and out leg movements. It works the shoulders and the lower abs together.
instructions: Sit on the floor leaning back slightly, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press the dumbbells overhead.
Pull your knees in, then extend the legs out as the weights stay up.
Lower the dumbbells to your shoulders.
Repeat, keeping your back long and core braced.

9041.description: With the front foot raised on a step and the bar on your back, you sink into a deep split squat. It loads the quads and glutes.
instructions: Set a low platform under the smith bar and put your front foot on it.
Place the bar across your upper back and unrack it.
Step the back foot behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand.
Do all reps, then switch legs.

9489.description: While hanging from a bar, you lean your body to each side to work the obliques and grip.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and legs together.
Brace your abs and keep your arms straight.
Lean your legs and hips toward one side, bending through the waist.
Return to centre under control.
Lean to the other side and alternate for the planned reps.

9873.description: A one-armed lying lateral raise across the body with a low cable. It isolates a single side delt and lets you fix imbalances.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench next to a low pulley and take the handle with the far hand.
Start with your arm across your body and a soft bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out and up in an arc until it reaches about shoulder height.
Hold for a moment, then lower with control.
Keep your torso still and your shoulder away from your ear.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

10065.description: A machine rotation that trains the abs and obliques with controlled twisting.
instructions: Sit in the machine and secure your torso against the pads.
Grip the handles.
Rotate your torso to one side while keeping your hips still.
Pause at the end.
Return to centre and rotate the other way.
Go slowly and avoid momentum.

10193.description: A conditioning move that pairs a burpee with a hard sled push for a tough full body effort.
instructions: Stand behind a loaded sled and drop into a burpee, chest to the floor.
Jump up to your feet explosively.
Grab the sled handles with your arms extended and lean in.
Drive with short, powerful steps to push the sled for a set distance.
Return and repeat, keeping your back flat while pushing.

10385.description: A lift that heaves the sandbag from the floor up onto your shoulder, building power and total body strength.
instructions: Stand over a sandbag and grip it firmly with both hands.
Lift the bag, driving through your legs and hips.
Pull it to your lap, then heave it up onto one shoulder.
Lower it to the floor with control.
Alternate shoulders each rep.

11089.description: A seated straddle position with a rolling spine movement. It loosens your back and inner thighs.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide in a comfortable split.
Sit tall and reach your arms forward.
Round your spine and roll down slowly, one segment at a time.
Roll back up slowly until you are upright.
Repeat for 8-10 slow reps without forcing the stretch.

11793.description: A gentle shoulder mobility drill pressing outward to warm up the joint.
instructions: Stand tall with your elbow bent at your side.
Press your forearm outward away from your body.
Hold for a moment at the end of your comfortable range.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

0017.description: A pull-up on an assisted machine that takes some of your weight, so you can build up to full pull-ups.
instructions: Adjust the machine to your desired weight and height settings.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms fully extended and your feet off the ground.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the handles, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the handles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将机器调整至您所需的体重和高度设置。
正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
双臂完全伸展，双脚离开地面。
收紧背部肌肉，将身体拉向手柄，保持肘部靠近身体。
继续拉，直到下巴位于手柄上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0081.description: A preacher curl with an overhand grip, hitting the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps.
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench with your chest against the pad and your arms extended straight down, holding a barbell with an overhand grip.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the barbell upward while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the barbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the barbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在牧师凳上，胸部靠在垫子上，手臂伸直向下，正手握住杠铃。
保持上臂静止，呼气并向上弯曲杠铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起杠铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且杠铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0145.description: A hip bridge lifting the buttocks off the floor while lying on your back. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat, hip width apart.
Place your arms at your sides.
Press through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Keep your ribs down and avoid overarching your back.

0209.description: A preacher curl on a cable with an overhand grip. It targets the brachialis and forearms while the pad keeps you strict.
instructions: Adjust the cable machine so that the preacher curl pad is at chest height.
Sit on the preacher curl bench and place your upper arms on the pad, with your palms facing down and your elbows fully extended.
Grab the cable handles with an underhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the handles towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the handles back to the starting position, fully extending your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整绳索机，使牧师弯举垫处于胸部高度。
坐在牧师弯举凳上，将上臂放在垫子上，手掌朝下，肘部完全伸展。
反手抓住电缆手柄，距离与肩同宽。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将手柄向肩膀卷曲，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将手柄放回起始位置，充分伸展肘部。
重复所需的重复次数。

0273.description: A crunch with your legs pointing straight up so you reach toward your toes. It works the abs with less hip flexor pull.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight up toward the ceiling.
Extend your arms toward your feet.
Curl your shoulders off the floor and reach toward your toes.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your legs still and your neck relaxed.

0337.description: A lying dumbbell triceps extension that moves across the face. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your head at the end of the bench.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight up above your chest, palms facing each other.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, slowly lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head until your forearms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then contract your triceps to bring the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，头放在长凳的末端。
双手握住哑铃，双臂伸直至胸部上方，手掌相对。
保持上臂静止，将哑铃在头后呈弧形缓慢降低，直到前臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后收缩三头肌，将哑铃带回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0401.description: Forearms rest on your thighs with palms up, and you curl the dumbbells with your wrists. It builds the underside of the forearms.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, allowing your wrists to hang off the edge.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, squeezing your forearms at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment, then lower your wrists back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心朝上。
将前臂放在大腿上，让手腕悬在边缘。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，在动作的最高点挤压前臂。
暂停片刻，然后将手腕放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0529.description: You swing two kettlebells from the floor to overhead in one motion. It builds the hips, shoulders and grip.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at arm's length in front of your thighs.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back flat and chest up.
In one explosive motion, extend your hips, knees, and ankles, and simultaneously pull the kettlebells up towards your shoulders.
As the kettlebells reach shoulder level, rotate your wrists and punch the kettlebells overhead, fully extending your arms.
Lower the kettlebells back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个壶铃，放在大腿前面，与手臂保持一定距离。
稍微弯曲膝盖，臀部向前转动，保持背部平坦，挺胸。
以一种爆发力动作，伸展臀部、膝盖和脚踝，同时将壶铃拉向肩膀。
当壶铃达到肩膀水平时，旋转手腕并将壶铃击过头顶，充分伸展手臂。
将壶铃放回起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

0593.description: Lying on a machine, you swing your legs up behind you. Works the glutes and lower back.
instructions: Adjust the leverage machine to fit your body and secure your feet in the foot pads.
Lie face down on the machine with your upper body hanging off the edge and your hips resting on the pad.
Cross your arms over your chest or place them behind your head.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your legs upward until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整杠杆机以适合您的身体并将双脚固定在脚垫中。
面朝下躺在机器上，上半身悬在机器边缘，臀部放在垫子上。
双臂交叉放在胸前或放在脑后。
用臀部和腿筋将双腿向上抬起，直到它们与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0657.description: A push-up with one hand on a stability ball. It makes the chest and shoulders work harder to stay stable.
instructions: Get into a push-up position with one hand on a stability ball and one on the floor.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Keep your core tight.
Finish your reps, then switch the ball hand.

0721.description: You pull your wrist gently with the other hand to stretch the forearm. Hold on each side.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended in front of you.
Extend your right arm out to the side, parallel to the ground, with your palm facing down.
With your left hand, grab your right hand and gently pull it towards your body, feeling a stretch in your right forearm.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat on the other side.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂在身前伸展。
将右臂向侧面伸出，与地面平行，手掌朝下。
用左手抓住右手，轻轻地将其拉向身体，感觉右前臂有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒，然后放松。
在另一侧重复。

0785.description: A cardio move that mixes a squat with a jumping jack. It raises your heart rate and burns the legs.
instructions: Start in a squat with hands together at your chest.
Jump your feet wide while staying low in the squat.
Jump your feet back together, still low.
Keep your chest lifted and knees over your toes.
Continue at a steady, quick pace.

0849.description: A seated twist on a stability ball holding a weight at the chest. It trains the obliques and builds core control.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell with both hands close to your chest.
Engage your core and slowly rotate your torso to one side, keeping your hips stable.
Pause for a moment at the end of the rotation, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat the rotation to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
双手靠近胸部握住杠铃片或哑铃。
启动你的核心并慢慢地将你的躯干旋转到一侧，保持臀部稳定。
旋转结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复旋转到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0913.description: A chest fly with the band at mid-chest height. It works the pecs through a sweeping motion.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and stand facing away.
Hold the ends with slightly bent elbows.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your pecs.
Return slowly.

0977.description: A front raise with a band, lifting straight arms to shoulder height. It trains the front delts.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band in front of your thighs with your palms facing down.
Keep your arms straight and lift the band up in front of you until your arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the band back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在大腿前面，手掌朝下。
保持双臂伸直，将弹力带举到身前，直到双臂与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将弹力带放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
